content: Implement the M0110 W0111 candidate transport ABI 0.x as one hashed schema manifest, generate C/C++ projections for the transport and Linux UAPI records, and prove deterministic layouts and golden bytes through CTest without changing the inherited M0100 descriptor.

Content revision 573bc0c adds the W0111 schema manifest, four hashed definitions, the deterministic C projection generator, Linux UAPI wrapper, and C17/C++20 fixtures. The validator passed with 4 definitions and 12 records; the focused CTest passed 3/3. Revision 31b6438 activates M0110/W0111 in the plan after this independently valuable contract stage.

W0111 remains Active because its exit gate also requires local and guest negotiation harnesses. The next owner is W0112; the schema/projection is ready for cdev implementation and the candidate remains ABI 0.x until W0114 qualification.
